value.rationale: The theorem settles the structural issue of whether larger total edge density can reverse the dependence between triangles and an arbitrary induced triangle-free motif. It provides a simultaneous all-size all-motif one-switch ordering, shows shape-invariance across nonisomorphic motifs with identical h,e, and documents a genuine negative-to-positive crossing. This is stronger and broader than isolated numerical covariance calculations.
